text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-26, a scheduler bug causing missed runs was discovered in worker/scheduler/cron.py affecting v1 SDK clients.","The root cause was schema drift between the database migration and the model.","The fix regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum via PR #1183 on branch fix/missed-run-1.","The bug manifested as a slot with no execution record in the background job scheduler.","The issue could be reproduced by advancing the fake clock across the schedule.","Test coverage for this issue exists in tests/worker/test_cron.py.","The backlog cleared within 24 minutes after the fix was deployed."]}
